title: Blind fixed-water-table validation of the C4Q representation frontier

reference_authority.rule: Compile the frozen D13 accepted-trajectory harness semantics against exactly this canonical source tree. Do not use the research branch source backend.
reference_authority.d13_reference_policy: strict first; only the harness-frozen integrated residual fallback classes; independent 1e-12 cm transaction mass gate; O0/O2 bit identity

frozen_physical_domain.bottom_boundary: zero pressure head at fixed 160-cm lower boundary

blind_initial_state_design.derivation: Use the half-offset grid of the predeclared quarter-lambda lattice over the D13 development envelope. Values are exact binary fractions and were fixed before any C4R Reference generation.

LARE.initial_projection: exact conservative layer integration of the finite-water-content initial profile

R2.route: same newly generated current-canonical accepted-trajectory harness

FMC_SMVE.equations: Frozen F-ROMV2-D13 groundwater-front equations, 200 moisture bins, i=100 baseline, j=101..199 active fronts, nine equal internal substeps per 0.001-day observation.
FMC_SMVE.implementation_reproduction_gate: Before reading any C4R Reference response, reproduce the immutable D13 FMC pooled metrics and decision from artifact 10587057124 within 1e-12 on all scalar metrics used by C4R.

diagnostics: systematic signed bias for storage, cumulative exchange and bottom flux

comparator_relative_frontiers.crosses_R2_GW: A QUALIFIED reduced LARE member is no worse than newly generated R2 on every GW_VECTOR component.
comparator_relative_frontiers.crosses_FMC_GW: A QUALIFIED reduced LARE member is no worse than frozen-equation FMC on every GW_VECTOR component.
comparator_relative_frontiers.crosses_R2_PROFILE: A QUALIFIED reduced LARE member is no worse than newly generated R2 on every PROFILE_VECTOR component.
comparator_relative_frontiers.crosses_FMC_PROFILE: A QUALIFIED reduced LARE member is no worse than frozen-equation FMC on every PROFILE_VECTOR component.

H_GW_DIMENSION_SEPARATION.development_observation: C4Q implies minimum reduced LARE dimension 4 against both R2 and FMC when only the comparator-relative GW_VECTOR is used.
H_GW_DIMENSION_SEPARATION.validation_test: Report whether the C4R blind minimum crossing dimension is again 4 for R2_GW and FMC_GW.

H_PROFILE_DIMENSION_SEPARATION.development_observation: C4Q all-five PROFILE_VECTOR minimum is R4 versus R2 and R12 versus FMC.
H_PROFILE_DIMENSION_SEPARATION.validation_test: Report exact blind minimum crossing dimensions without retuning or dropping the profile axis.

H_ACTIVE_LOWER_ZONE.development_observation: R8, R12 and R16 had nearly identical balance/bottom-flux errors while profile error continued to fall as more upper-profile resolution was retained.
H_ACTIVE_LOWER_ZONE.validation_test: Report R8/R12/R16 GW_VECTOR differences separately from mapped-profile differences; no new tolerance is introduced.

decision_logic.C4R_BLIND_PROFILE_FRONTIER_REPLICATED: Hard gates pass and at least one reduced LARE member crosses FMC_PROFILE and at least one crosses R2_PROFILE.
decision_logic.C4R_BLIND_GW_FRONTIER_ONLY: Hard gates pass; no reduced member crosses FMC_PROFILE but at least one reduced member crosses FMC_GW and at least one crosses R2_GW.
decision_logic.C4R_BLIND_R2_FRONTIER_ONLY: Hard gates pass; at least one reduced member crosses R2_GW but no reduced member crosses FMC_GW.
decision_logic.C4R_BLIND_REDUCED_FRONTIER_NOT_REPLICATE: Hard gates pass but no reduced LARE member crosses R2_GW.
decision_logic.C4R_REFERENCE_OR_EXECUTION_BLOCKED: Any Reference authority, FMC reproduction, R16 LARE control or fail-closed integrity gate fails.

interpretation_boundaries: Comparator-relative crossing is not application acceptance.
No absolute hydrological tolerance is selected from C4Q or C4R.
C4R histories are blind with respect to C4Q development evidence, but the representation families and frontier metrics are intentionally frozen from prior evidence.
No cost, speedup, amortization or production claim is evaluated in C4R.
Failure of exact development minimum-dimension replication does not automatically negate the representation family; the complete vector and dimension curve must be reported.

pre_execution_implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: history materialization, current-canonical execution plumbing, blind metric aggregation only
